architecture_contract.atac_decoder: chromosome-factorized decoder with sigmoid output interpreted as per-peak accessibility probability
architecture_contract.model: asymmetric spliced autoencoder with RNA and chromosome-factorized ATAC encoders/decoders and four reconstruction/cross-translation paths
architecture_contract.native_losses: negative-binomial RNA loss plus binary-cross-entropy ATAC loss, including RNA-to-ATAC and ATAC-to-RNA cross losses
architecture_contract.warning: The historical training script preprocesses and clusters the full dataset before its internal split. That path is leakage-incompatible and cannot be used unchanged for donor-held benchmarking.

implementation.pretraining_corpus_declared_by_authors: paired human 10x Multiome PBMC plus COLO-320DM and COLO-320HSR colorectal cell lines

inductive_inference_contract.designed_behavior: A frozen BABEL model accepts RNA rows and emits ATAC probabilities in its exact frozen peak order without observed ATAC or model updating.
inductive_inference_contract.feature_constraint: The hosted v1.1 checkpoint requires its exact rna_genes.txt and atac_bins.txt registries; intersection, padding, duplicate-gene policy, genome build, and coverage must pass a fixed fixture.
inductive_inference_contract.liver_domain_warning: The declared checkpoint corpus is PBMC and colorectal cell lines, not liver or MASLD. Domain shift must be reported and cannot be repaired on held donors.
inductive_inference_contract.pretrained_status: Blocked from execution until code and weight permissions, SHA-256, size, archive inventory, safe-loading inspection, and runtime fixtures pass.

input_contract.atac_training_input: raw paired ATAC counts, binarized to x greater than zero by the native loader
input_contract.feature_alignment: Exact ordered genes and chromosome-sorted peaks; any local implementation must use training-only features mapped to GENCODE v49 and GRCh38.p14
input_contract.rna_input: raw RNA counts; the native loader derives size-normalized targets and log-normalized encoder inputs
input_contract.warning: BABEL training is supervised on paired modalities. GSE244832 cannot be used as paired training data.

output_contract.rna_to_atac: probability between zero and one for every frozen checkpoint peak; upstream warns probabilities are not guaranteed calibrated
output_contract.rna_reconstruction: continuous expression in linear, not log, space
output_contract.uncertainty: The published loader exposes one checkpoint. Project five-seed uncertainty applies only to separately permitted local training; it cannot be invented from a single hosted model.

runtime_contract.declared_environment: Python 3.7, PyTorch 1.3, CUDA 10.1, anndata 0.6.22, scanpy 1.4.4, numpy 1.17, pandas 0.25, scikit-learn 0.21, skorch 0.7

safe_loading_contract.risk: gdown extracts an external archive and skorch load_params ultimately deserializes PyTorch checkpoint material. Neither archive paths nor serialized objects have been inspected.
safe_loading_contract.required_before_acquisition: Written authorization, exact redistribution/use terms, immutable download receipt, declared MD5 plus computed SHA-256 and size, path-traversal-safe archive inventory, and offline safe-deserialization review.

source_evidence: The exact public repository revision, README, environment, model loader, data loader, training/prediction scripts, architecture, and losses were inspected as text on 2026-08-22. The repository has no license file. No package, checkpoint, archive, or weights were downloaded, installed, extracted, deserialized, or executed.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Not admitted. The hosted model is a translation checkpoint, and its unlicensed code/weights and legacy stack fail current gates.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Scientifically direct-fit because RNA-only inference emits a peak profile, but operationally blocked by permissions, identity, safe-loading, legacy runtime, feature-build, and domain-shift gates.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible because BABEL has no DNA sequence or allele-effect mechanism.
